title: 第3章
content_zh:
女生们笑嘻嘻挤成一团唱《我是女生》，男生们就起哄，勾着手指：“对面的女孩看过来，看过来，看过来。”
“那我可要伤心太平洋了，班长，班长？换歌！我要唱《伤心太平洋》！”
高中生们在过元旦联欢，雾蒙蒙的玻璃，热腾腾的脸，教室里挂满了彩纸和气球，酣绿交错蒸红。
六班的教室里，只有贺图南一个人在角落磕瓜子，幽焚焚的眼，像两口深井，有点儿笑模样，浮在上头。
同学们让他也唱一首，他没推辞，羽绒服脱了，只穿件黑色毛衣，人薄薄的。
一九九八的夏天，这座北方城市的大街小巷店铺最爱放两首曲子，一首是电影《泰坦尼克号》主题曲，一首就是法国世界杯的《the  cup  of  life》。
教室的灯，似乎没那么明亮，亮光都在贺图南身上，他这人看着闷闷的，可一点不扭捏，恰如此时此刻，好像全世界都没什么事会比唱好这首歌重要，他学习时很投入，玩乐时也很投入。
他有个很有钱的爸爸，所以，联欢会的瓜子花生糖果都是贺图南买的，好似举手之劳，这让近两年家中父母下岗的同窗们，内心五味杂陈。
“贺图南，老徐八成掉厕所了，我去看看。”班长开了句玩笑，往外走。
元旦当天，贺图南回校拿两本复习资料，途径附近劳务市场，意外见到了徐牧远的爸爸。
说是劳务市场，不够正式，离学校大概也就五六百米，天不亮，就黑压压站了一群人，揣着手，等工头挑人。
徐牧远的爸爸，在九八年年初正式下岗，其实，早有苗头，先是放了个长假，后来说要改革，工人们接受不了这要革掉铁饭碗，拉起横幅，堵了路，在大马路上吵架。
贺图南坐在父亲的车里，看见过那一幕，那时，他刚中考完，路上被工人堵得水泄不通要说法，浪潮一般，裹着每个人也不知道要往哪里去。
再后来，位于城市北部的工厂区里，整条产线的机器，被领导悄摸不响卖了，徐牧远的爸爸靠领保障金带着全家过日子，他炸过油条，腌过咸菜，听说什么挣钱就做什么，无一例外全部失败。
贺图南所在的市一中，有许多来自工北区的孩子，现在，工北区黄了，可书还没念完呐。
自行车驶过人前，贺图南和徐叔叔四目一对，认出彼此，徐叔叔似乎想别过脸去，为时已晚，只能堆起个尴尬的笑，脸皮干，扯得紧绷绷的疼，这个中年男人连雪花膏都不舍得抹了。
说完就走，中年男人呆呆目送他远去，脸像纸折的，风稍微再吹动一下就会断掉。
content_en:
The girls huddled together and sang "I'm a Girl" with smiles, and the boys cheered and clucked their fingers: "The girl opposite, look here, look here, look here."
"Then I'm going to be sad in the Pacific, monitor, monitor? Change the song! I'm going to sing "Sad in the Pacific"!"
The high school students were celebrating the New Year's Day party, with foggy windows and hot faces. The classroom was filled with colored paper and balloons, and the bright green alternated with steaming red.
In the Class 6 classroom, He Tunan was the only one cracking melon seeds in the corner. You Fenfen's eyes were like two deep wells, with a slight smile floating on them.
The classmates asked him to sing a song, but he did not refuse. He took off his down jacket and was only wearing a thin black sweater.
In the summer of 1998, there were two favorite songs played in the streets and alleys of this northern city. One was the theme song of the movie "Titanic" and the other was "The Cup of Life" from the French World Cup.
The lights in the classroom did not seem so bright, and the light was all on He Tunan. He looked dull, but he was not shy at all. At this moment, it seemed that nothing in the world was more important than singing this song well. He was very devoted when studying and also very devoted when playing.
He has a very rich father, so He Tunan bought all the sunflower seeds and peanut candies for the party, which seemed like a piece of cake. This made the students whose parents had been laid off in the past two years feel mixed in their hearts.
"He Tunan, Old Xu probably fell into the toilet. I'll go take a look." The squad leader joked and walked out.
On New Year's Day, He Tunan returned to school to pick up two review materials. He passed by the nearby labor market and unexpectedly met Xu Muyuan's father.
It was said to be a labor market, but it was not formal enough. It was only about five or six hundred meters away from the school. Before dawn, a group of people stood in the dark, hands folded, waiting for the foreman to pick someone.
Xu Muyuan's father was officially laid off at the beginning of 1998. In fact, there were already signs of this. First, he took a long vacation, and then he announced the need for reforms. The workers could not accept the idea of ​​losing their iron job, so they held up banners, blocked the road, and started quarreling on the street.
He Tunan had seen that scene while sitting in his father's car. At that time, he had just finished his high school entrance examination, and the road was blocked by workers who wanted to preach. The wave was like a wave, covering everyone and not knowing where they were going.
Later, in the factory area in the north of the city, the entire production line of machines was quietly sold by the leaders. Xu Muyuan's father lived with his family on the security deposit. He fried fried dough sticks, made pickles, and did whatever he heard to make money, but all failed without exception.
There are many children from Gongbei District in the No. 1 Middle School where He Tunan is located. Now, Gongbei District is yellow, but they haven't finished their studies yet.
As the bicycle passed in front of people, He Tunan and Uncle Xu looked at each other and recognized each other. Uncle Xu seemed to want to look away, but it was too late and could only put on an awkward smile. His face was dry and stretched so tight that it hurt. This middle-aged man was not even willing to put on cream.
After saying that, he left. The middle-aged man watched him go away blankly, his face was like an origami, and it would break if the wind blew it a little more.
